description: [capability-version: 0.9.93] The debug-only Tauri MCP automation bridge (tauri-plugin-mcp-bridge, registered in src-tauri/src/app_plugins.rs). Split from default.json because the plugin is not a dependency on Windows: its WebView2 screenshot code is built against webview2-com 0.38 while tauri 2.12 uses 0.39, so it does not compile there (see its entry in Cargo.toml). tauri-build refuses a capability naming a permission no compiled plugin defines, so the grant is scoped to the platforms that carry the plugin. Add windows back when the plugin moves back to [dependencies].
